fields.heading: The tools you will *learn*
fields.intro: Each one is taught hands-on in the masterclass, on the day shown. Days 31 to 60 belong to the Full program.

fields.heading: Sixty days, *in four stretches*
fields.intro: The 30-day Foundation is the first three. The 60-day Full program adds the fourth.

steps.title: Days 1–10: prompting and everyday AI
steps.text: Prompt frameworks, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in depth, Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, research tools and NotebookLM.

steps.title: Days 11–25: content, websites and a first app
steps.text: AI presentations, images, video, voice and avatars, Canva AI and data analysis, then prompt-to-website and building and shipping an app.

steps.title: Days 26–30: capstone and Demo Day
steps.text: Plan, build, test and present a project of your own, with a portfolio page and a map of your next steps.

steps.title: Days 31–60: agents, automation and RAG
steps.text: Voice agents, n8n automations and WhatsApp bots, MCP, RAG and multi-agent systems, then Claude Code and local models.

items.question: What does Artificia do?
items.answer: We teach AI and we build with it: a live masterclass for individuals, custom training for company teams, and AI systems for businesses.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: In Vadodara, Gujarat. Our office is on Gotri-Sevasi Road, opposite Osia Mall, and the masterclass is taught in person in Vadodara.

items.question: Do I need to know coding to learn AI?
items.answer: No. The masterclass is designed for beginners and non-technical learners. You learn by using the tools, step by step.

items.question: How long is the masterclass?
items.answer: One hour a day, on one of two tracks: the 30-day Foundation, or the 60-day Full program, which adds agents, automation, RAG and Claude Code.

items.question: Are classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Live and in person. Each class has a short opener, the core idea, a live demo and hands-on practice, with your questions answered in the room.

items.question: Can you train our whole team?
items.answer: Yes. Corporate programs are built around your documents and departments, on-site or online over Microsoft Teams. The first step is a free 2-hour pilot.

items.question: Which industries do you train?
items.answer: Programs are built from your own documents and work, so they fit any sector. The corporate training page shows how they work for manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical, chemical, import-export and finance teams.

items.question: What is a flow audit?
items.answer: A free 15-minute call. We trace one process from enquiry to delivery, mark where time is lost, and show what to automate first.

fields.heading: Training a team? Try a *free pilot*.
fields.text: One 2-hour session on AI and prompting for your staff, with no commitment. Judge the training before you decide.
